registered: 2026-10-14, before any EURUSD data before 2010 was downloaded
origin: fx_structure_results.txt (F1, 2010-2026): EUR fell 1.45bp a day during European hours (07:00-12:00 UTC), t -3.6. That was found in the data, not registered, so 2010-2026 cannot test it. This registration tests it on history it has not seen.
rule: each weekday, short EURUSD from 07:00 UTC to 12:00 UTC (the same fixed UTC window as F1, daylight saving ignored)
data: HistData EURUSD M1, 2001-01 to 2009-12 (out of sample in time). Secondary, reported but not part of the pass: the same window on EURJPY 2010-2026, which shares the EUR leg but not the USD leg.
costs: one round trip a day: 1 pip (0.0001) as registered, and 2 pips reported as a stress (spreads were wider before 2010)
pass: 2001-2009 net mean per day > 0 at 1 pip with t >= 2.0, and the gross mean has the same sign as in 2010-2026. Otherwise it is a 2010-2026 artefact.
after: A pass goes to a forward demo record on the owner's account, with the actual spread logged; the EA would only trade it if the logged spread keeps the net positive.
